query:
UPDATE teams SET
             name = COALESCE($2, name),
             prompt_template = COALESCE($3, prompt_template),
             agents_md = COALESCE($4, agents_md),
             primary_model_provider_key = CASE WHEN $5 THEN $6 ELSE primary_model_provider_key END,
             primary_model_id = CASE WHEN $7 THEN $8 ELSE primary_model_id END,
             small_model_provider_key = CASE WHEN $9 THEN $10 ELSE small_model_provider_key END,
             small_model_id = CASE WHEN $11 THEN $12 ELSE small_model_id END,
             review_primary_model_provider_key = CASE WHEN $13 THEN $14 ELSE review_primary_model_provider_key END,
             review_primary_model_id = CASE WHEN $15 THEN $16 ELSE review_primary_model_id END,
             review_small_model_provider_key = CASE WHEN $17 THEN $18 ELSE review_small_model_provider_key END,
             review_small_model_id = CASE WHEN $19 THEN $20 ELSE review_small_model_id END,
             review_enabled = COALESCE($21, review_enabled),
             review_max_turns = COALESCE($22, review_max_turns),
             review_prompt_template = COALESCE($23, review_prompt_template),
             max_in_progress_tasks = COALESCE($24, max_in_progress_tasks),
             agent_backend = COALESCE($25, agent_backend)
             WHERE id = $1
             RETURNING id, name, personal_user_id, prompt_template, agents_md, primary_model_provider_key,
              primary_model_id, small_model_provider_key, small_model_id, review_primary_model_provider_key,
              review_primary_model_id, review_small_model_provider_key, review_small_model_id,
              review_enabled, review_max_turns, review_prompt_template, max_in_progress_tasks, agent_backend,
              created_at as "created_at!: chrono::DateTime<chrono::Utc>"
